head: render
method: the labels-derived crossover. Isotonic regression (pool-adjacent-violators, ties pooled, non-decreasing) of P(the human said >=3) against this head's own P(>=3), over all 5896 labeled smooth_render pictures scored through the shipped render artifact; the crossing is the LOWEST score whose fitted agreement reaches 0.5, and the floor is that crossing rounded UP. Rounded up because a floor rounded down admits material the fit did not vouch for.
reference_pool: all 5896 labeled smooth_render pictures, over 2728 places, read through the shipped render
